posts.text: Q1FY27 result & concall- AUM up 24% to 11,284 cr, while Net income & profit grew slower. Gross & net stage 3 saw a spike YoY and hence becomes key monitorables. The co. switched disbursement realisation method & hence disbursement took a hit in the quarter. “During the quarter, the company consciously transitioned to recognizing disbursements on check realization rather than check handover. This transition is aligned with strong operational controls and the impact of same is onetime in nature. posts.text: Hi @cdas3317 Are you still following this company? After great results and performance since listing last few quarters have become inconsistent and more worryingly issues are recurring. 30+DPD is the highest since listing at 5.2%,GNPA and NPA is also higher and credit cost is at higher end of guidance at 50 bps. AUM growth has also slowed down to sub 25% Management has said Q1 is seasonally weak but even YoY numbers are high.
